newsitem.title: UK: Racal sees Data Products Pft next year.
newsitem.headline: Racal sees Data Products Pft next year.

text.p: Racal Electronics Plc said on Tuesday that it expected its troubled Data Products division to return to overall profitablity in the the year ending April 1998.

In a statement with its interim results, which showed a sharp drop in first-half pre-tax profit largely due to a 10.1 million stg charge for the reorganisation of Data Products, Racal confirmed the details of Monday's profits warning. It said it expected Data Products "to generate a modest profit at the operating level" in the second half of the current year.
